text: Experts believe that general AI—machines that can do any intellectual task a human can—may become a reality one day. This is often called AGI, or artificial general intelligence. Supporters say AGI could bring amazing benefits, such as curing diseases, solving climate change, and giving everyone more free time. However, there are serious risks too. Some experts worry that AGI might be difficult to control or could take jobs away from millions of people. Predictions about when AGI will arrive vary widely. Some say it could happen in ten to twenty years, while others think it is still far away. Nobody knows for sure.
